plan.change: Make candidate Change Operations regression tests compatible with valid exact-blob pending authorization state.
expectedChanges: Teach candidate regression fixtures to interpret the current registry transitionPolicy.
In steady state, continue requiring every contracted repository blob to equal expectedBlob.
In pending state, allow only the transition target repository blob to equal fromBlob while registry expectedBlob equals toBlob; all unrelated contracts must still equal expectedBlob.
Keep the copied contracted test repository faithful to the actual candidate repository bytes rather than synthesizing future toBlob content.
Update the repository/registry consistency test to accept exactly the same steady or pending state machine already enforced by the trusted executor.
Add regression cases proving malformed pending metadata, wrong target blob, and unrelated mismatch remain failures.
hqDecisions: Do not change the trusted executor, registry, workflow, or exact-blob authorization model.
Candidate regression tests may understand pending state, but they must not create any new authorization rule beyond the already trusted steady/pending model.
The pending exception is one path only and allows the repository file to remain at fromBlob during authorization.
plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: Regression-fixture compatibility repair only; authenticated human attestation remains the later C3-3 target.
plan.rollback: Revert this staging-only test repair if pending candidate regression can accept any state rejected by the trusted executor.
unverified: After this repair merges, the previously prepared C3-3 verifier preauthorization must be recreated from the new staging main with a fresh r0.
plan.problem: A valid registry-only pending authorization is accepted by the base-owned trusted executor but candidate Change Operations Tests still assert every registry expectedBlob equals the current repository file, causing normal CI to fail.
plan.currentContract: The trusted C3-2 transition model allows steady->pending authorization with one target path where repository file remains at fromBlob and registry expectedBlob is already toBlob. Candidate test fixtures still assume only steady state.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: The fixture-level unconditional equality makes every legitimate authorization PR red, contradicting the documented tests->PR->CI->merge workflow even though trusted enforcement is correct.
plan.design: Add a small test-only parser for transitionPolicy and a repository-contract assertion helper. In steady, all actual blobs equal expectedBlob. In pending, metadata must be canonical, target expectedBlob must equal toBlob, actual target blob must equal fromBlob for authorization-stage candidate tests, and every unrelated actual blob must equal expectedBlob. copyContractedFiles copies actual repository bytes without asserting future equality, while the dedicated consistency assertion validates the state machine.
alternativesRejected: Change the trusted executor to accommodate the tests; the trusted runtime is already correct.
Disable candidate regression tests during authorization PRs; that would hide unrelated regressions.
Copy synthetic future content into test fixtures; that would stop testing the actual candidate repository state.
Remove repository-vs-registry consistency checks; stale registry drift would become invisible.
plan.migration: No registry or evidence changes. The currently red C3-3 preauthorization branch remains unmerged and will be superseded after this package merges.
plan.compatibility: Steady-state behavior remains identical. Only valid one-path pending authorization is newly accepted by candidate regression fixtures.

pending target path must exist in contracts.
pending target expectedBlob must equal toBlob.
pending authorization-stage actual target must equal fromBlob.
unrelated actual blobs must equal their expectedBlob.
